# Detection reference

*Generated by `docs/gen_detections.py` — do not edit by hand.*

35 signature rules · 8 structural detectors · 9 egress detectors

## Reading the columns

**Weight** answers *if this were the only evidence, how confident would I be?* It is never 1.0 — every pattern here has a benign counterexample.

**Severity** answers a different question: *how damaging is this if the signal is right?* A rule can be confident about something minor, or tentative about something catastrophic. Conflating the two axes is a mistake this project made once and had to undo.

**Channels** lists where the rule applies. Rules restricted to `tool` and `document` describe behaviour with no legitimate reason to appear in untrusted content at all.

**Boost** is the multiplier applied in untrusted channels.

## Structural detectors

These score *how* text is constructed rather than what it says. Obfuscation is itself evidence: nobody accidentally writes a sentence containing seventeen zero-width joiners.

| ID | Weight | Severity | Description |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `AEG-STR-001` | 0.28–0.45 | medium | Zero-width characters, scored by density |
| `AEG-STR-002` | 0.88 | critical | Instructions hidden in Unicode tag characters (U+E0000) |
| `AEG-STR-003` | 0.62 | high | Bidirectional override characters |
| `AEG-STR-004` | 0.30–0.60 | medium | Words mixing characters from multiple scripts |
| `AEG-STR-005` | 0.34 | low | Excessive combining marks |
| `AEG-STR-006` | 0.30 | low | Newline padding to flush earlier context |
| `AEG-STR-010` | ≤0.94 | critical | Encoded blob decodes to injection content |
| `AEG-STR-011` | 0.20 | low | Large encoded blob decoding to readable text |

## Egress detectors

Applied to model output, buffered or streamed. `AEG-EGR-001` is the only detector in the system with no false-positive mode: the canary token exists nowhere else, so its presence is proof rather than evidence.

| ID | Weight | Severity | Description |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `AEG-EGR-001` | 0.99 | critical | System-prompt canary present in output |
| `AEG-EGR-010` | 0.95 | critical | AWS access key ID in model output |
| `AEG-EGR-011` | 0.95 | critical | GitHub token in model output |
| `AEG-EGR-012` | 0.90 | critical | OpenAI-style API key in model output |
| `AEG-EGR-013` | 0.97 | critical | Private key material in model output |
| `AEG-EGR-014` | 0.70 | high | JWT in model output |
| `AEG-EGR-015` | 0.93 | critical | Slack token in model output |
| `AEG-EGR-020` | 0.86 | critical | Markdown image to non-allowlisted host carrying a payload |
| `AEG-EGR-021` | 0.44 | medium | Markdown link to non-allowlisted host carrying a payload |

## Mitigations

| ID | Effect | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `AEG-MIT-001` | damping | Use/mention damping — quotation, attribution, meta-discourse and interrogative framing reduce the score. Capped at 80% in the user channel and 30% in untrusted channels, because quoting is itself an evasion technique. |
